title: Mission revision diff
mapLegend: Before: orange dashed line / large markers. After: green solid line / small markers. All points in a changed route are shown. Select a marker for its revision and waypoint.
mapUnavailable: No resolved coordinates are available for the changed routes. Source coordinates remain in the list.
scope: Compares group radios, unit presets and loadouts, weather, date and start time. Numbers use the DCS source units (m, m/s, seconds, mmHg, radio in MHz). Unset and zero are distinct. The direction is fixed: Before is the older file you chose, After is the version open now.
differentTheatre: The maps differ, so coordinates cannot be compared directly. The map overlay is disabled.
emptyTitle: To compare revisions, choose the older file
emptyBody: With a mission open, choose File > Compare revisions and pick the older .miz. It is compared with the version open now.
